title: Kenyan-Style Pilaf with Mincemeat
description: A flavorful and aromatic Kenyan-inspired dish combining pilaf with sweet and tangy mincemeat.
instructions: Heat buttery in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add mincemeat and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cover. Simmer for 10-12 minutes or until liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
